title: centaurea margaritacea subsp. dubjanskyi
intro: Centaurea margaritacea subsp. dubjanskyi, commonly known as the Caucasian cornflower or mountain cornflower, is a plant species native to the Caucasus region. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Centaurea margaritacea subsp. dubjanskyi include wound healing, antiseptic, and antiviral activities, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents in this plant have been shown to possess antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions.
